children: Svenska Aerogel Holding AB (publ) (“Svenska Aerogel” or “the Company”) is launching a new short-form interview series highlighting the people and companies representing the Company in markets around the world.

Through a series of short Q&As, Svenska Aerogel’s distributors share their perspectives on local market trends, customer needs and application opportunities for Naerogel®, providing insights into how demand for efficient material solutions is developing across different markets.

“Our distributors have valuable knowledge of their local markets and work closely with customers to identify new opportunities for Naerogel®. With this series, we want to share some of these insights and introduce the people behind our international distribution network,” says Tor Einar Norbakk, CEO of Svenska Aerogel.
The series begins with José Miguel Ortega, Technical Director at Comindex - part of the IMPAG Group, Svenska Aerogel’s distribution partner for Iberia and Morocco.
Read the first interview:   Comindex - Part of IMPAG Group

Svenska Aerogel manufactures and commercializes the mesoporous material Naerogel®. Svenska Aerogel's business concept is to meet the market’s need for new materials that are in line with global sustainability objectives. Naerogel® is flexible and can be tailored to different applications to add essential properties to an end product. The company's vision is to be the most valued business partner providing pioneering material solutions for a sustainable world.
Svenska Aerogel Holding AB is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market. Certified Adviser is FNCA.
